ja.evidence_note: AI の例の音は、AI ごとにスコアが高い上位 5 区間です。人が聞いて確かめた音ではありません。人が聞いて確かめた音と、精度の確認で答えた音は、元の区間の長さのまま別に保存しています。
ja.methods_note: 検出は各AIが一度に調べる長さの区間を使い、決めたスコアと等しい区間も「声あり」と数えます。元の予測・回答は書き換えず、人の確認で決めた閾値（確認が済んでいないときは既定の閾値）を全対象区間に当てています。確かめても閾値を決められなかったAIの検出は数えません。新しい確認では、期間内の全区間をスコアの順位で6組に分けます。既定の閾値以上の検出区間が最上位の組（上位3.125%）より少なければ、最上位の組を検出区間そのものにし、残りを元の下位5組の幅の比で分けます。各組から10音を無作為に選び、10音以下ならすべて聞きます。追加の音はありません。以前に作った確認は元の順位による6組と、必要に応じた最大18音の追加を保ちます。各確認の抽出方式と回答は保存記録に含まれます。声が入っていた区間の割合と区間数は組ごとのベータ分布（事前分布0.1）から、AIのスコアの閾値・正しい検出の割合・見つけた割合・AUPRCはスコアのロジットに対するロジスティック曲線から求めています。
ja.region_source: 「この季節・地域ではまれ」の印は、BirdNET 2.4の地域モデルで付けています。地点の緯度・経度について、期間内に録音のある週（BirdNETの週。1年を48週に分ける）ごとに出現確率0.03以上の種を求め、どの週にも入らない種に印を付けます。印はすべてのAIの結果に付けるだけで、結果を除くことはしません。
ja.precision_note: 正しい検出の割合（精度）は、AIが「声あり」と数えた区間のうち、本当に声があった割合です。見つけた割合は、声があった区間のうち、AIが「声あり」と数えた割合です。見つけた割合は範囲が広いので、年や種の比較には使わないでください。AUPRCは、声のある区間をAIがスコアの上位に並べられた度合いで、1に近いほどよいことを示します。数値の幅は、ほぼ確実な範囲（90%）です。
ja.validation_scope: 結果は、対象期間のすべての区間（AIごとの3秒または5秒）についての推定です。「判断できない」と答えた音は計算に使いません。声が入っていた区間が全体の1%未満と推定された種では、珍しい種のため、見つけた割合を示しません。
ja.human_reference: 利用者の聞き取り判定を参照した評価です。人の判定そのものが常に正しいことや、別の地点・期間でも同じ性能になることを保証する値ではありません。

ja.figure_detection: AIが声ありと数えた時間の割合（白：0%）

ja.method_text: 精度を確かめるときは、AI のスコアが高い音から低い音まで、まんべんなく選んだ音を人が聞きました。その答えから、「声あり」と数えた区間の 9 割以上に本当に声が入っていると見込める、いちばん低いスコアを閾値にしました。精度と見つけた割合も同じ答えから見積もった値で、「おそらく〜の間」はその幅（90%）です。「判断できない」と答えた音は計算に使っていません。人の答えがいつも正しいことや、別の地点・期間でも同じ結果になることは保証できません。計算の細かい手順は、このフォルダの README.txt に書いています。
ja.method_scope: この地点で取り込んだ録音のうち、期間に重なるものを対象にしました。日付をまたぐ録音は、期間の中の部分だけを数えています。対象の録音と AI の版は、このレポートを保存した時点のものです。

en.title: Wildlife calls in these recordings
en.copied: Copied. Paste into Word or another editor.
en.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the report text and copy it manually.
en.copy_hint: To draft another report, copy the text and tables, and save the figures you need.
en.region_unusual_note: BirdNET's range prediction says this species is rare at this place in this season (the record needs careful confirmation).
en.rare_recall: Too few intervals contained the call to estimate how many were missed
en.partial_coverage: These results cover only part of the recordings. They do not describe the whole recording collection.
en.custom_models_note: This species-specific AI was built from sounds marked This species in the search list, voice/no-voice labels on 5-second search results, and Not heard answers from 5-second checks. It is checked and counted on 5-second intervals.
en.presence_files: "Confirmed by listening" record per species (number of sounds heard, not-found records)
en.all_scores: Every eligible score, including intervals the AI did not count as containing the call (3 or 5 seconds, depending on the AI)
en.evidence_files: Audio files and how they link to AI examples, sounds confirmed by listening and accuracy-check answers
en.validation_files: Accuracy checks: how sounds were chosen, answers, thresholds and results
en.custom_model_files: AIs made for one species and their training provenance
en.files_note: Open index.html in this folder to read the text, figures and tables and play the audio offline. To share it, send the whole ZIP; the recipient should extract it before opening.
en.evidence_note: AI examples are the five highest-scoring intervals per result, not human confirmations. Listening evidence and check answers are saved separately at their original interval lengths.
en.methods_note: Detection uses each AI's input interval and counts scores equal to the selected score as containing the call. Original predictions and answers remain unchanged. The score threshold decided by checking, or the documented default threshold while the check is not finished, is applied to all eligible intervals. Detections of an AI whose check could not decide a threshold are not counted. New checks divide all intervals in the period into six groups by score rank. If detections at the AI's default threshold are fewer than the top group (top 3.125%), the top group becomes exactly those detections, and the remaining intervals are split in the relative widths of the original five lower groups. Ten sounds are drawn at random per group; groups of ten or fewer are fully sampled. No extra sounds are added. Older checks retain their original six rank groups and optional extension of up to 18 sounds. Each check's sampling method and answers are saved. Call density and interval counts come from per-group Beta distributions (prior 0.1); the AI score threshold, precision, recall and AUPRC come from a logistic curve over the logit of the score.
en.region_source: The “Rare here in this season” mark comes from the BirdNET 2.4 range model. For the site's latitude and longitude, it lists the species with an occurrence probability of 0.03 or higher in each BirdNET week (the year is split into 48 weeks) that has recordings in the period. Species missing from all of those weeks are marked. The mark is added to results from every AI; no results are removed.
en.precision_note: Precision is the share of intervals the AI counted as containing the call that really did. Recall is the share of intervals with the call that the AI counted. Recall ranges are wide; do not use them to compare years or species. AUPRC shows how well the AI ranks intervals with the call above those without; closer to 1 is better. The spans shown are almost-certain ranges (90%).
en.validation_scope: Results estimate all intervals in the period (3 or 5 seconds, depending on the AI). “Cannot tell” answers are not used. When fewer than 1% of intervals are estimated to contain the call, the species is too rare here to estimate missed calls, so recall is not reported.
en.human_reference: User annotations are the reference. These estimates do not establish that human judgements are always correct or that performance transfers to another site or period.
en.figure_undecided: No score threshold could be decided, so this AI's detections are not counted.
en.figure_detection: Share of time the AI counted as containing the call (white: 0%)
en.figure_missing: Pale grey: no recording · Dot: ineligible · Colour + dot: partial analysis
en.figure_caution: Failure to find a call does not establish absence.
en.decided_precision: Of detections scoring {score} or higher, about {value} were correct (90% range {low}–{high}, {answered} sounds checked)
en.decided_score: Accuracy checked and score threshold decided (AI scores of {score} or higher are counted)
en.undecided: Accuracy checked, but no score threshold could be decided (too many false detections, or the answers varied)
en.undecided_no_target: Accuracy checked, but no sound was answered “Heard”, so no score threshold could be decided
en.audio_unavailable: The audio file for this sound is not included
en.tile_heard: species whose call a person heard and confirmed
en.tile_counted: species counted by an AI whose accuracy was checked
en.tile_selected: species in this report (chosen by you)
en.table_reference: how often it is correct is not known yet
en.table_unused_no_target: the AI could not tell this call apart
en.table_unused_other: no way to count could be decided
en.absence_note: Not finding a call, or a species not being listed, does not mean the species was absent.
en.reading_windows: The AI cuts the recordings into short intervals (3 seconds for BirdNET, 5 seconds for the other AIs) and gives each one a "score" from 0 to 1. Intervals scoring at or above a chosen value (the threshold) are counted as "call present". Counts are numbers of intervals, not numbers of calls or animals. Because the interval lengths differ, counts from different AIs are not added together.
en.reading_figure: In the circular figure, dates move from the centre outward, and the time of day (0–24 h) runs around the circle.
en.legend_red: Darker red: the AI counted a larger share of that hour as "call present"
en.legend_note: Hours without recordings are not read as hours without calls.
en.heard_note: A person listened and answered that these sounds are the call of {name}. These are not AI detections.
en.not_found_text: A person listened to the {count} highest-scoring sounds but could not confirm the call of this species.
en.ai_none: This species was not examined by any AI.
en.rule_checked: Scores of {score} or higher count as "call present" (a value set from what people heard)
en.rule_default: Scores of {score} or higher count as "call present" (the preset value, not set by people listening)
en.count_text: {count} intervals ({rate} of the {eligible} intervals examined). Days with detections: {days}
en.precision_text: Of the intervals counted as "call present", about {value} were correct (probably between {low} and {high}; estimated from {answered} sounds that people listened to)
en.precision_missing: The accuracy was checked, but the share of correct detections could not be calculated
en.precision_unknown: Not checked yet, so how often it is correct is not known
en.precision_in_progress: The accuracy check is not finished, so how often it is correct is not known yet
en.precision_stale: An earlier accuracy check no longer matches the current recordings or AI. How often it is correct is not known (it needs to be checked again)
en.unused_no_target: People listened to the sounds the AI scored highest, and none contained the call of {name}. This AI cannot tell the call of {name} apart, so neither its counts nor its figure are used in this report.
en.unused_other: People listened to the sounds the AI scored highest, but many were not {name}, or the answers varied, so no way to count could be decided. Neither its counts nor its figure are used in this report.
en.no_figure: No AI detection figure is included (see "AI detections").
en.figure_alt: AI detections of {name} by date and time of day ({model})
en.examples_note: These are examples chosen by the AI. People have not listened to confirm them.
en.schedule_text: Recording covered {share} of the period (on average {hours} hours a day). Each line is one recording (site local time). Point at the figure (or touch it on a phone) to see the time and length of the nearest recording.
en.schedule_label: When recording happened. {period}, {days} days with recordings, {hours} hours in total.
en.limits_title: What these recordings cannot tell you
en.limits_text: Not finding a call does not mean the species was absent. These data alone cannot tell you about times without recordings, numbers of animals, breeding, where a call came from, or conservation effects across an area. Before submitting to a scheme, check what the receiving body requires.
en.details_note: Use these when you cite the evidence behind the numbers, or when someone else checks them.
en.detail_checks: Detailed accuracy check results (by AI and species)
en.checks_none: No AI has had its accuracy checked yet.
en.source_none: could not be decided, so not counted
en.detail_estimated: Intervals likely to contain the call
en.range_wide: ; wide because few sounds were heard
en.recall_text: Of the intervals that contained the call, the AI counted {about}
en.disagreement: Caution: the AI scores did not match the answers well. The threshold, accuracy and share found are less certain than the ranges shown.
en.detail_files_note: How the sounds were chosen and every answer are kept in the files (validation/).
en.detail_play_all: Listen to all {count} answered sounds (including "not heard")
en.detail_method: How counting and accuracy checks work
en.method_text: To check accuracy, people listened to sounds chosen evenly from the highest to the lowest AI scores. From their answers, the threshold was set to the lowest score at which at least 9 in 10 intervals counted as "call present" are expected to really contain the call. Accuracy and the share found were estimated from the same answers; "probably between" gives that range (90%). "Cannot tell" answers were not used. This does not guarantee that people's answers are always right, or that another site or period would give the same result. The detailed calculation is described in README.txt in this folder.
en.method_scope: All recordings imported for this site that overlap the period are included. For recordings that cross midnight, only the part inside the period is counted. The recordings and AI versions are those at the time this report was saved.
en.quiz_note: These are the latest practice results for questions whose answer was this species. Practice shows the answer immediately and may repeat the same sounds, so it does not measure how well field sounds are identified. It is not used in any count or accuracy calculation.
en.file_hourly: Counts by date and hour (data behind the circular figures)
